retrieve_secret_from_manager: retrieve a secret from Azure Key Vault, AWS KMS, Google KMS, or other secret manager backends
decrypt_google_kms_secret: decrypt a base64-encoded Google KMS secret using the KeyManagementServiceClient
decrypt_aws_kms_secret: decrypt a base64-encoded AWS KMS ciphertext blob and return the plaintext value
read_secret_from_custom_manager: read a secret from a custom secret manager implementing the CustomSecretManager interface
check_string_is_base64: check if a given string is valid base64-encoded data
